text_block_list.text: The final day of summer camp—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Huh? Craft isn't here yet?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that girl.
Hold on, I'll go call her over.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Craaaft?
The bus is gonna get here soon~!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
(...? Where could she be?
Don't tell me she's still sleeping in her room—)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...*inhale*...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: (I fell asleep...!)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Geez...
Craft, wake up. It's about time to head home.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...*inhale*...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: If you don't wake up, I'm leaving you behind~!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...*inhale*...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Maybe I should just leave you behind and go to that new Japanese cafe we promised to visit all by myself~

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...*inhale*...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I'm not gonna do that tandem training
you asked for either!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...*inhale*...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll be running in the 'Queen Elizabeth II Cup'
all by myself too, after all—"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: N-Nooooo!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: "...Ah! Huh?! Oh, it was a dream...!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Hk, pfft! Ahaha!
Geesh, don't scare me like that, Craft.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
S-Sorry, my bad~!
Wait... huh? Where is everyone?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
They're waiting outside. I just came to fetch you.
Come on, the bus is gonna arrive soon, let's hurry!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Wah-wah, yeah!

And so,
the hectic summer training camp came to an end.
